name: Osu to Mesu no Kankei ~Cool na Imouto to Atsukurushii Ore no Ano Natsu~
original_name: オスとメスのカンケイ　～クールな妹と暑苦しい俺のあの夏～
source:
As I was living by myself while attending university, my younger sister came to visit. Due to family circumstances, she would be living with me for a while.
It had been years since we last met, and she seemed far more grown up than as I remembered her.

This kind of feeling...
translation:
由于我在读大学时一个人住，我的妹妹来看望我。由于家庭原因，她要和我住一段时间。
我们上次见面已经很多年了，她看起来比我记忆中成熟得多。

这种感觉…
